subject: PO mapping & invoice fingerprint — multiline invoices, net30, weekly micro-invoicing
messages:
From: Rajesh Menon <r.menon@healthsql.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@healthsql.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO 45321 — multiline invoice mapping + cadence question

Hi Aisha,

Attached is PO 45321 for the upcoming Redwood deployment. Procurement flagged a few constraints we need to confirm before we finalize:

- The PO has three line items spanning two legal entities (US entity + EUR subsidiary). We need invoices to preserve line-level mapping (PO line -> GL code) so our ERP can auto-post.
- Our AR team will only accept invoices with an "invoice fingerprint" field (a short reference) that we push into our AP system. Can Redwood include a consistent invoice reference token on each invoice?
- We want net30 payment terms, but would prefer to receive weekly micro-invoices for usage so we can reconcile consumption against budgets. Is that possible without changing net30?
- Each invoice must show the purchasing BU tax id and the PO number in the header.

I've attached the PO PDF and our procurement contact is copied. Please let me know if you need a template for the invoice JSON that our ERP expects.

Thanks,
Rajesh
Rajesh Menon
Head of Procurement, HealthSQL
procureops@healthsql.com
Attachment: HealthSQL_PO_45321.pdf

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Menon <r.menon@healthsql.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@healthsql.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO 45321 — multiline invoice mapping + cadence question

Hi Rajesh — thanks for the PO and the clear list. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying asks below. Looping in Vanessa (sales) to confirm billing lane options and Priyom from finance for the invoice token behavior.

- Multiline mapping: Yes, we can include PO line mapping on each invoice and emit per-line GL/BU tags. Please confirm the exact GL field names your ERP requires (we can map on our side).
- Invoice fingerprint: we can surface a stable invoice_reference token on each invoice (alphanumeric, up to 32 chars). Is there a required prefix or format (e.g., HSQ-PO#_YYYYMMDD)?
- Weekly micro-invoices + net30: possible — we can generate weekly usage invoices and still keep net30 payment terms (each invoice carries its own net30 due date). This will create multiple outstanding invoices for the same PO; is that acceptable for your AP workflow?
- Tax IDs: we can print the purchasing BU tax id on invoices per legal entity. We will need the exact tax ids for the two entities and the preferred remit-to address for each.

Next steps we propose:
1) Vanessa will confirm whether this qualifies for our "micro-invoice" billing lane (small-volume weekly invoices) vs standard monthly statements.
2) Priyom will share a sample invoice (PDF + JSON payload) showing the invoice_reference and PO-line mapping.
3) If OK, we can do a 15-min call with your ProcureOps team to confirm the ERP field names and EDI/endpoint for invoice pushing.

Can you confirm the ERP system name and whether you prefer SFTP, EDI 810, or a secure API for invoice ingestion?

Cheers,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Menon <r.menon@healthsql.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: PO 45321 — multiline invoice mapping + cadence question

Rajesh — appreciate the clear ask. Short confirmation from billing side: we can support the model you described with two caveats and a recommended path.

Caveats:
- Weekly micro-invoices are supported, but to avoid AP noise we'll flag each set of weekly invoices as a single "statement bundle" for your ledger so reconciliation can be done at statement level if you prefer. Each invoice will still be payable on net30.
- Because the PO spans two legal entities, we will emit separate invoices per legal entity (one invoice per entity per week) so tax reporting remains correct. That means some weeks you may see two invoices for one period.

Recommended path / deliverables we will provide:
1) Sample invoice PDF and a machine-readable JSON payload that includes: invoice_reference, po_number, po_line_mapping (line_id, unit_price, quantity, gl_code, bu_tag), purchaser_tax_id, remit_address, hubspot_deal_id.
2) A short mapping template (Excel) to map our invoice fields to your ERP GL fields (link above).
3) If you want the invoice_reference format standardized, we suggest: HSQ-45321-YYYYMMDD-<seq> (we can generate that server-side).

Operational ask for your ProcureOps team:
- Please confirm ERP name and preferred transfer method (SFTP/EDI/API). If EDI, point us to the 810 spec variations you require.
- Share the tax IDs and remit addresses for both legal entities.

If these look good, we can turn on a billing pilot (2 weeks) to send weekly invoices and validate automatic posting in your system. Happy to schedule the call — how's Thursday 8/6 at 10am PT?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: billing-mapping-template.xlsx (stub)

From: ProcureOps <procureops@healthsql.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rajesh Menon <r.menon@healthsql.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO 45321 — multiline invoice mapping + cadence question

Thanks — this works. A few confirmations from procurement:

- ERP: Workday Finance. Preferred transfer: SFTP drop and an API push for metadata. We do not use EDI 810.
- Invoice_reference format: HSQ-45321-YYYYMMDD-<seq> is acceptable. Please ensure the token is included both as a visible invoice field and in the invoice metadata (JSON).
- We accept separate invoices per legal entity per week (Workday will auto-post to the correct legal entity if the tax id is present).
- Please send the sample PDF + JSON payload to procurement@healthsql.com and the mapping spreadsheet to our ERP team.

Also, legal will need the contract redline before we enable the pilot. Can someone from Redwood loop in legal or push the current SOW + contract to our DocuSign link?

ProcureOps
ProcureOps Team
procurement@healthsql.com
